regime.label: median of 7 donors, temperature-corrected
regime.derivation: race/practice degradation ratio, stint-fixed-effects estimator on both sessions; each donor's log ratio corrected by the thermal sensitivity (+0.025/degC) times its race-minus-practice track temperature, residuals pooled with the median: australia-2026 0.75x (dT +2 degC -> 0.72), japan-2026 0.73x (dT +2 degC -> 0.70), barcelona-2026 0.70x (dT +2 degC -> 0.66), austria-2026 0.58x (dT +2 degC -> 0.56), belgium-2026 0.32x (dT -5 degC -> 0.37), hungary-2026 0.64x (dT +17 degC -> 0.42), italy-2026 0.81x (dT +2 degC -> 0.78) -> management residual 0.66x (spread 0.24 ln); at spain-2026 practice ran at 50 degC and the race is expected at 53 degC (forecast supplied), so the pool gives 0.71x, so 0.71x applies; the old pooled geometric mean would have given 0.63x. spain-2026's own race is never used

net_step.derivation: fresh-tyre step prior 0.178 s (calibrated (0.21% of lap time)). The races identify the *net* cost of one step harder over a whole stint, holding stint length and race phase fixed: australia-2026 +0.317 +/- 0.345 s; japan-2026 -0.069 +/- 0.664 s; barcelona-2026 +0.060 +/- 0.336 s; austria-2026 +0.106 +/- 0.295 s; belgium-2026 +0.075 +/- 0.323 s; hungary-2026 -0.010 +/- 0.327 s; italy-2026 +0.173 +/- 0.354 s -> pooled +0.108 +/- 0.131 s per step. The model's fresh-tyre offsets are calibrated so that, with its own degradation ladder, it reproduces this net at the stint length it recommends.
